published_terms_findings: Article 5.2 permits a licensee to create its own machine-readable database, publication, service or other product containing or made on the basis of EPO database data, while excluding a copy of the database or data as such from that product definition.
Article 5.4 prohibits making the EPO database, a copy, or the data as such public or distributing the data as such unless expressly authorized by the EPO in writing.
Article 10.2 requires the specified EPO attribution statement in products, websites and interfaces through which products containing sourced EPO data can be accessed.
rights_evidence.note: Published generic terms establish relevant control requirements but do not establish whether the exact Autumn 2025 order, acceptance, amendment history, or separate written permission grants additional rights.

Any separate written EPO authorization relevant to public redistribution.
